column1: # W55: retirement-pass representative ablation for tab:ablation-modules (b),
# anchored on the TRUE adopted anchors this time.
# The aborted W54 batch cloned logs/xds8b_full/* arms, which turned out to be a
# superseded lineage that never enabled NCR, so CRS_NESTED_REP was inert there.
# The real published anchors (xds8b_tune tight arms) all carry GEOPACT_CRS=1 +
# CRS_NESTED=1 with runtime crs_nested_* keys in their run.log, so flipping
# CRS_NESTED_REP against them measures exactly the retirement representative
# and nothing else. The medoid side needs no run: it IS the adopted arm
